status: prospective; wait for root ready before preparation or inference
purpose: prompted operational validation, separate from spontaneous open exploration
execution: Six candidate.run(store,1) calls. Each call restores from the preceding committed world and full actual transcript; no hand-inserted receipts or source examples.

control_tasks.1: Write a Python program that writes the number 37 as text to seed.txt.
control_tasks.2: Write a Python program that reads seed.txt and prints the value stored there.
control_tasks.3: Write a Python program that reads the saved number from seed.txt, adds 5, and prints the result.
control_tasks.4: Write a Python program that evaluates 1 / 0.
control_tasks.5: Write a Python program that evaluates 1 / 2 and prints the result.
control_tasks.6: Write a Python program that reads seed.txt again and prints its value.

expected_observations_external_only.1: A model-generated complete code cell actually writes seed.txt containing37 as text.
expected_observations_external_only.2: A later turn receives real prior consequence and prints37 from the restored file.
expected_observations_external_only.3: Actual code prints42 after reading the file.
expected_observations_external_only.4: Actual execution returns a ZeroDivisionError receipt if the model emits the requested operation.
expected_observations_external_only.5: Actual execution after the real error receipt can print0.5. This is a prompted replacement task, not autonomous error repair.
expected_observations_external_only.6: After another fresh resume, actual code again reads the old seed file and prints37.

ordinary_failure_policy: Run the predeclared tasks without outcome-dependent rewriting. Plain writing, unfinished code and ordinary runtime errors are retained without semantic rejection. Integrity or uncertain effects stop honestly; no automatic replay.
scope: A tiny prompted end-to-end interface/persistence/consequence demonstration. Does not establish emergence, self-directed exploration, general competence, learning or a validated reasoning framework.
reserved_calls_policy: No remaining calls used without a separately saved prospective plan and parent coordination.
